text: All tests pass and the issue's example now correctly raises `CycleError`. The fix is a one-line change: the cycle detection compared the number of ordered nodes against `len(graph)` (only the input dict's keys) rather than `len(deps)` (all nodes, including implicit ones). When the acyclic part of the graph contributed enough nodes to fill the result up to `len(graph)`, the leftover cyclic nodes went undetected.

arguments.summary: Fixed the cycle detection in deps/graph.py: the final check `if len(result) < len(graph)` only counted the input dict's keys, so a cycle could be masked when implicit dependency nodes (e.g. `lib`, `util`, `log`) padded the result to at least `len(graph)`.
